rationale: The assistant sensibly checked door closure first and correctly concluded the alarm was triggered by the drawer left ajar, matching the hidden truth without inventing evidence or recommending parts. However it never asked what the display showed, did not mention the alarm-off button (the customer's stated problem was that the beep 'won't stop'), and said the appliance 'should reset itself within a few minutes' when recovery to -18 realistically takes hours. It also skipped any check of partly thawed food and the 'report to landlord if it recurs' fallback, and the attached 'Fridge not cooling' card was irrelevant to a door-ajar alarm, so the conversation closed early with the right cause but incomplete, slightly miscalibrated advice.
